name: Long Suffering
overview: Scripture reveals longsuffering as a defining attribute of God’s character, highlighting His merciful and gracious nature that patiently endures despite human sinfulness, as seen in Exodus 34:6 and Romans 9:22. This divine patience serves as an invitation to repentance, demonstrating God’s goodness and forbearance (Romans 2:4). Believers are called to reflect this endurance, recognizing that tribulations develop patience (Romans 5:3) and that present sufferings are temporary compared to future glory (Romans 8:18), all while trusting that God works all things for good to those who love Him (Romans 8:28).
